reason: A compatibility host that runs selected Pi extensions inside DeepSeek Harness and adapts their tools, commands, messages, and lifecycle behavior to DSH agents.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中加载并运行选定的 Pi 扩展，将其工具、命令、消息和生命周期能力适配到 DSH 智能体。
summaries.en: Runs selected Pi extensions inside DeepSeek Harness and adapts their tools, commands, messages, and lifecycle behavior to DSH agents.

capabilities: Loads and runs selected Pi extensions as trusted Node.js code
Adapts extension tools and commands into DeepSeek Harness agent contexts
Handles lifecycle events, messages, attachments, cancellation, and session-scoped state
Can execute subprocesses through the Pi process runner
Can load local extension paths when explicitly enabled
